name: Helena
message: 「Good morning, members of the Student Council! I am Helena Kujou, chairwoman of Ryuusei Academy!」

name: Helena
message: 「Ufufu, welcome. This is my private room. Its name is 'Helena's Room♪'」

name: Helena
message: 「Since you're here, I'll introduce everything one by one.」

name: Helena
message: 「First is the 'Trophy Gallery.' You can bask in self-satisfaction looking at the trophies I've gifted you during the game.」

name: Helena
message: 「What's more, when you collect these trophies... ufufu.\s04」

name: Helena
message: 「That's a surprise for after you collect them♪」

name: Helena
message: 「Next is 'Helena's Training Grounds.' You can do mock exercises of battles that took place in the game.」

name: Helena
message: 「Here, you can choose from three modes: Easy, Normal, and Hard.」

name: Helena
message: 「Aim for high scores and G-Class in your favorite battles♪」

name: Helena
message: 「And so, welcome to Helena's Room! Have plenty of fun!」
